town_description: Fatehpur Sikri is a town in Agra district, Uttar Pradesh, founded by Akbar in 1571 as the capital of the Mughal Empire and abandoned within decades. Its red-sandstone palace city, Jama Masjid, and Buland Darwaza make it a UNESCO World Heritage Site and a major tourist destination near Agra.
